title: Two planes collide on taxiway at Miami airport one day after national grounding
summary_full: Two people injured after wingtip of Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck nose of United Parcel Service Boeing 767Two planes collided with one another on a taxiway at Miami’s international airport on Saturday night – a day after the Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) issued an hours-long nationwide ground stop due to communication issues affecting multiple air traffic control centers.In a statement, the Trump administration-led FAA said the wingtip of a Copa Airlines Boeing 737 struck the nose of a United Parcel Service Boeing 767 “while the airplanes were taxiing at Miami International Airport”.
